$comment: Advisories in production dependencies that scripts/audit-gate.mjs will not
block on. Add an entry only when the advisory cannot be reached from
Archyne's own code — not because a fix is inconvenient.
id       the GHSA identifier, as printed by `npm run audit`
reason   why it is unreachable here, in one sentence a reviewer can check
expires  ISO date; on and after it the gate fails again, so the
exception gets re-read rather than becoming permanent
Keep this list empty when you can. An entry is a promise to look again.
